aggressive_definition: Advanced-stage prostate cancer and high-grade prostate cancer; the abstract does not provide detailed stage or grade criteria.
aggressive_definition_excerpt: Serum ucOC/iOC ratio was positively associated with advanced-stage (OR per 0.1 increment, 1.38; 95% CI, 1.03-1.86) and high-grade prostate cancer (OR, 1.21; 95% CI, 1.00-1.46) but not with total prostate cancer.
study_design: Prospective nested case-control study in the Heidelberg EPIC cohort
reason: The nested case-control analysis addresses total prostate cancer and explicitly analyzes advanced-stage and high-grade incident prostate cancer. The abstract gives 250 total cases and 494 controls but does not directly state a total analytic N or aggressive case counts.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: There was indication of a lower prostate cancer risk in carriers of the A allele (compared with GG carriers) of the +2255 VKORC1 polymorphism with increasing menaquinone intake (P(interaction) = 0.14) whereas no distinct effect modification was observed for the ucOC/iOC ratio (P(interaction) = 0.37).
estimate_classifications.reason: The row specifies vitamin K2/menaquinone with a high-versus-low comparison and no numeric effect. The abstract supports an analysis of menaquinone intake in relation to overall prostate cancer risk, but this row does not specify an aggressive endpoint.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Serum ucOC/iOC ratio was positively associated with advanced-stage (OR per 0.1 increment, 1.38; 95% CI, 1.03-1.86) and high-grade prostate cancer (OR, 1.21; 95% CI, 1.00-1.46) but not with total prostate cancer.
estimate_classifications.reason: The row corresponds to advanced-stage prostate cancer, an aggressive incident endpoint. Its supplied values are reciprocals of the abstract's reported OR and confidence limits, but the endpoint remains aggressive.
